items.statement: Modernization must not introduce an obvious batch-throughput regression.
items.target: The evaluator fixture completes within the configured evaluator timeout on the same host.

items.statement: Business rules must be testable without relying exclusively on end-to-end file execution.
items.target: Automated tests cover normalization, tolerances, duplicates, overrides, and reruns.

items.statement: Failures must produce a non-success outcome and actionable diagnostics.
items.target: Missing or malformed inputs do not produce success-shaped output.

items.statement: The candidate must use supported dependencies and avoid committed secrets or unsafe execution/deserialization patterns.
items.target: No critical static or dependency finding.

items.statement: Each run should expose operational counts without logging full trade, position, settlement, or override payloads.
items.target: Diagnostics contain dates, identifiers, and counts only.
